map.CPM 低就一定好？: Is a low CPM always good?
map.OTS 为广告总曝光机会，Reach 为覆盖人群比例，GRP 为到达率与频次之积: OTS is the total advertising exposure opportunity, Reach is the proportion of the audience covered, and GRP is the product of reach and frequency.
map.OTS（接触机会）= 日均流量 × 广告牌数 × 天数；Reach（到达率）=: OTS (opportunity to see) = average daily traffic x number of billboards x days; Reach = people who noticed / target audience x 100%; GRP (gross rating point) = Reach x average frequency
map.→ 打开户外（广告/投放/评估）方法工具: -> Open the out-of-home (advertising / placement / evaluation) method tool
map.不一定。CPM 只反映'千人成本'，还要看人群匹配度（是否是目标客群）与停留环境: Not necessarily. CPM only reflects the cost per thousand people; you also need audience match (are they the target segment?) and the environment they are in when they see the ad. A premium core district has a high CPM but may convert better, so it has to be judged together with back-end conversion.
map.广告尺寸与分辨率转换（像素/毫米）: Ad size and resolution conversion (pixels / millimetres)
map.户外大牌有效触达与 CPM: Effective reach and CPM of a large out-of-home billboard
map.投放前用流量与注意率做多方案模拟，选定'触达够、单价低'的点位组合。: Before placing, simulate several plans with traffic and attention rate to pick a combination of locations that gives enough reach at a low unit cost.
map.来自第三方调研或媒体提供的环境注意系数，通常 5%–20% 不等，受点位视线、遮: An environment attention factor from third-party research or media, commonly ranging from 5% to 20% and affected by sightlines, occlusion and traffic speed. An optimistic estimate overstates reach, so take a conservative value and note the source.
map.注意率（Recall/Notice Rate）怎么估？: How is the attention rate (recall / notice rate) estimated?
map.用总投放费用 ÷ 有效触达，算 CPM（每千人次成本），横向比不同点位性价比。: Divide the total placement cost by the effective reach to get the CPM (cost per thousand people) and compare the value of different locations side by side.
map.路牌、公交候车亭等户外媒体，按日均人/车流量 × 广告牌数量 × 投放天数 ×: For out-of-home media such as roadside signs and bus shelters, estimate the effective reach from average daily people or vehicle flow x number of boards x days of placement x attention rate.
map.针对户外广告位选址、投放周期与曝光估算，提供评估方法与效果对照，适用于户外媒体采: For out-of-home site selection, placement cycles and impression estimates, it provides evaluation methods and effect comparisons, suitable for out-of-home media purchasing, comparing placement plans and a first-cut ROI judgement.
map.：日均人流量 50000、广告牌 3 块、投放 30 天、注意率 15%。有效触: : average daily footfall 50,000, 3 boards, 30 days of placement and a 15% attention rate give an effective reach of 50,000 x 3 x 30 x 0.15 = 675,000 impressions. With a total placement cost of 90,000 CNY, CPM = 90,000 / 675,000 x 1000 ~= 133.3 CNY per thousand.
